description: Unit tests for the MessageHeadersBuilder class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.messages package, testing various header construction scenarios.

classes.name: MessageHeadersBuilderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for MessageHeadersBuilder, testing header creation, validation, and error scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of MessageHeadersBuilder before each test.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullDirection
methods.description: Tests that creating a MessageHeadersBuilder instance with null direction throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating a MessageHeadersBuilder instance with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSubject
methods.description: Tests that creating a MessageHeadersBuilder instance with null subject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithEmptySubject
methods.description: Tests that creating a MessageHeadersBuilder instance with empty subject throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidSubject
methods.description: Tests validation for invalid message subject formats.

methods.name: createInstanceFromMinimalMap
methods.description: Creates MessageHeaders from a minimal valid map and verifies correctness.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromMapWithoutThingId
methods.description: Ensures missing mandatory headers result in exception.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromEmptyJsonObject
methods.description: Tests header creation from empty JSON object results in error.

methods.name: setFeatureIdWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies setting featureId adds the correct header.

methods.name: tryToSetEmptyFeatureId
methods.description: Checks that empty featureId strings are rejected.

methods.name: tryToSetUnknownStatusCode
methods.description: Ensures unknown HTTP status codes trigger exceptions.

methods.name: setStatusCodeAsIntWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies setting a known status code results in correct header value.

methods.name: putValidHeadersWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests insertion of valid custom headers.

methods.name: tryToPutMapWithInvalidDittoHeader
methods.description: Ensures invalid header values are rejected with specific exception.

methods.name: tryToRemoveMandatoryHeader
methods.description: Verifies that mandatory headers cannot be removed.

methods.name: tryToRemoveMandatoryHeaderBySettingToNull
methods.description: Checks that attempting to overwrite mandatory headers with null raises errors.

methods.name: tryToPutInvalidHeader
methods.description: Tests validation for headers with invalid format or values.

methods.name: setTimestampAsString
methods.description: Verifies timestamp parsing from string works as expected.
